connector.name: Captapi
connector.registryDescription: Social media data: 85 tools across 11 platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X & more), one key.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.captapi.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cdcstream account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CAPTAPI_API_KEY
env.description: Your capt_live_... API key. Create one at https://captapi.com/dashboard/api-keys (100 free credits).

env.name: CAPTAPI_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the Captapi API base URL (default https://api.captapi.com).
